questions.question: After `name=Asha`, what does `echo 'Hello $name'` print?
options: An error, because single quotes are not allowed with echo
questions.explanation: Single quotes make everything literal, so the variable is not expanded. Double quotes would print Hello Asha.

questions.question: Why is `cd /opt/old-release && rm -r cache` safer than `cd /opt/old-release ; rm -r cache`?
options: && runs rm only if cd succeeded, so a failed cd will not delete cache in the wrong directory
&& runs both commands in parallel, which is faster
&& automatically asks for confirmation before rm
questions.explanation: With ;, rm runs regardless of whether cd worked, so it could delete a cache directory wherever you happen to be. && checks the exit status first.

questions.question: You need documentation for the format of the /etc/passwd file rather than the passwd command. Which command shows it?
questions.explanation: Section 5 of the manual covers file formats. Plain man passwd shows section 1, the command.

questions.question: A script runs a command and `$?` is 127. What most likely happened?
questions.explanation: Exit status 127 is what the shell returns when it cannot find the command, often because of a typo or a missing PATH entry.
